headline: Prime-angle SSE but only knee-to-waist — glassy dawn or don't bother.
today: The angle is bang-on for Lido but there's only 1.5ft at 6.5s behind it, so it's a log day at best. Get on it during the morning light SSW glass because the SSE onshore fills in by afternoon and shuts it down. Longest board you own, mid to high tide.

daysToWatch.note: Sizey day topping out near 4.7ft on a good angle, but the wind is cross-on all day and hits 17mph by afternoon. Morning is the least messy — surf early.
Chest-high on a good angle with a light NW cross-off at dawn easing the morning. Cleanest window of the week — get there early.
Onshore S wind all day. Bumpy and disorganized, one to sit out.
